name: Cham Islands food guide
summary: Order the catch with rice and little spice: fish soup, a light braise, a salty braise, fried fish, and dried fish grilled or simmered. Mực một nắng is tube squid dried one sun, sweet when it was dried the day it was caught, and bánh ít and bánh su sê wait in the pier baskets.
body: Fish, shrimp, squid, and swimming crab come first, then greens, then meat. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00. When the kitchen changes the rice, the plates are braised pork, boiled pork, pork-bone soup, salty glazed ribs, or stir-fried meat with roots and fruit, and sometimes bún or mì. Lobster, ốc vú nàng, and abalone have left the daily table. Stone crab is a visitor catch, and only from 1 March to 31 July.

Mực một nắng is squid dried one sun. Nước lá Lao is a leaf drink, called particular to the island in 2014 and, in 2017, also known from the same leaves elsewhere in Quảng, astringent when cooked. Bánh ít and bánh su sê are the cakes in the pier baskets. Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm is the registered nest. In May 2026 the grades yến quang, yến thiên, and yến bài were quoted from nearly 100 million to nearly 180 million VND a kilogram. That figure is the product, not a bowl.
specialtiesLead: Squid dried one sun leads. The catch, the fish paste, the afternoon bowls, the leaf drink, and the pier cakes follow.

sections.heading: Plates from the catch
paragraphs: Fish soup, fish braised lightly, fish braised salty, fried fish, cá cháy, and dried fish grilled or simmered, then the fish paste, the greens, the sauce, the cakes, the nest, and the drink.

sections.heading: Afternoon noodles
paragraphs: Mì Quảng is the afternoon bowl on the Bai Lang coast road and by the well in Bai Ong, beside bánh xèo chả cá, bánh canh, and bánh bèo.

sections.heading: Breakfast on the coast road
paragraphs: Breakfast stalls line the Bai Lang coast road and sit by Giếng Xóm Cấm in Bai Ong.

spots.name: Bai Lang coast road
spots.address: Thôn Bãi Làng, xã Tân Hiệp
spots.note: Morning stalls along the Bai Lang coast road, and by the well in Bai Ong.

seoTitle: Cham Islands food — the catch and squid dried one sun
seoDescription: Fish with rice and little spice, squid dried one sun, and bánh ít at the pier on Tân Hiệp. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00.
